prompt: Which price is the open of a candle?

options.text: The last traded price in the period
The first traded price in the period
The highest traded price in the period
The average of all traded prices in the period

explanations.a: The last traded price is the close, not the open.
explanations.c: The highest traded price is the high of the candle.
explanations.d: A candle does not use an average. It uses the first, highest, lowest and last prices.

prompt: Hypothetical candle: open Rs 300, high Rs 308, low Rs 296, close Rs 297. What is the upper shadow in rupees?
solution: The top of the body is the higher of open and close. Here the open is 300 and the close is 297, so the top is 300. Upper shadow = 308 minus 300 = 8. Check: a value of 11 comes from using the close (308 minus 297) as the top of the body, which is the wrong top here.

prompt: Hypothetical candle: open Rs 300, high Rs 308, low Rs 296, close Rs 297. What is the body in rupees?
solution: Body = |close minus open| = |297 minus 300| = 3. Check: 300 minus 297 = 3, the same size without the sign.

prompt: A trader says: 'The candle is green, so the price will rise tomorrow.' Which reply is best?

options.text: Agreed. Green candles come before a rise.
A candle describes one past period. It does not say what tomorrow will do. Colour is a display setting, so check the close against the open.
Only true when the volume is high.
Green means the close was below the open.

explanations.a: A candle describes a past period. No single candle predicts the next day.
explanations.c: Volume does not turn a description into a forecast. The candle still describes only one period.
explanations.d: Colour is set by the tool. It does not define the close against the open. Read the legend.

prompt: Hypothetical candle: open Rs 500, high Rs 512, low Rs 497, close Rs 497. Spot the mistake: 'The close is the low, so the candle is bullish.' Which part is wrong?

explanations.a: This part is true in this candle. The close is Rs 497 and the low is Rs 497.
explanations.c: This part is true. The open of this candle is Rs 500.
explanations.d: There is a mistake. A close below the open is bearish. Rs 497 is below Rs 500, so the candle is bearish.

prompt: Which of these does a single candle NOT show? Choose all that apply.

options.text: The order of the trades inside the period
The volume, which is the number of shares traded
What the next candle will do

explanations.c: The open is one of the four numbers a candle shows.
explanations.e: The high is one of the four numbers a candle shows.
